verses.en: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.sm: Ua mavae nei mea ona fāsia lea e Tavita ia Filisitia, ma na faatoilaloina i latou; ua faoa foi e Tavita Meti-ama ai lima o Filisitia.

verses.en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.sm: Ua ia fāsia foi Moapi, ona fuatia lea O i latou i le maea, o loo lafo i latou i le eleele, ma na fuatia i latou i maea e Jua e fasioti ai, ma le maea auau e faaola ai. Ua faia foi Moapi ma pologa ia Tavita, ua latou au mai ai taulaga.

verses.en: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.sm: Ua fasi foi e Tavita ia Atatesa le atalii o Reopo, le tupu o Sopa, ina ua alu atu O ia e faaoo lana pule i le vaitafe o Eufirate.

verses.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
verses.sm: Ua maua foi e Tavita nai ia te ia o e tietie i solofanua e tasi le afe ma le fitu galau, ma “au e savavali, o tagata e lua sefulu o afe; ona vaevae lea e Tavita o ua o vae o solofanua i kariota uma; a ua faasao ai mána o kariota e selau.

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.sm: Ua o mai Suria nai Tamaseko e fesoasoani ia Atatesa le tupu o Sopa, ona fāsia lea e Tavita o Suria e lua sefulu o afe, ma afe e lua o tagata.

verses.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.sm: Ona tuu lea e Tavita o leoleoga i Suria Tamaseko; ua fai ma pologa Suria ia Tavita, ua latou aumaia taulaga. Ua faasaoina Tavita e le ALII i mea uma na ia fealuai ai.

verses.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ua avea e Tavita o talita auro sa i ai i auauna a Atatesa, ua ia au mai ai i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.sm: A o Peta ma Perota o aai a Atatesa, na avea ai e le tupu o Tavita O apa memea e matua tele lava.

verses.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.sm: Ua logona e Toi le tupu o Amato, ua fasia e Tavita ‘au uma a Atatesa,

verses.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.sm: ona auina mai lea e Toi o lona atalii o Iorama i le tupu o Tavita e alofa atu ia te ia, ma faafetai ia te ia, ina ua la tau o ia ma Atatesa, ma ua fasia o ia e ia; aua sa va tau Toi ma Atatesa. Ua au mai foi E ia o ipu ario, ma ipu auro, ma ipu “apa memea.

verses.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
verses.sm: O mea foi ia sa faasa e le tupu o Tavita i le ALII, atoa ma le ario ma le auro sa na faasaina mai nuu ese uma sa na faatoilaloina ;

verses.en: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.sm: o Suria, ma Moapi, ma le fanauga a Amoni, ma Filisitia, ma Amaleka, ma vete mai ia Atatesa le atalii o Reopo le tupu o Sopa.

verses.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
verses.sm: Ona viia lea o le suafa o Tavita ina ua foi o ia nai le fasiga o Suria i le vanu masimaá, o tagata e sefulu afe ma afe e valu.

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuu foi o leoleoga i Etoma; o Etoma uma lava ua ia tuu i ai leo. leoga; ua fai ma pologa Etoma uma ia Tavita. Ua faasao e le ALII ia Tavita i mea uma na ia fealuai ai.

verses.en: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.sm: Ua faia Tavita ma tupu i Isaraelu uma, ua fai foi e Tavita le faamasinoga ma le tonu i lona nuu uma lava.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.sm: O Ioapo le tama a Seruia, ua pule o ia i ‘au; o Iosefatu le atalii o Ailuta, o le fatua‘iupu O ia;

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.sm: o Satoka le atalii o Akitopo, ma Aimeleka le atalii o Aviata, o faitaulaga i laua; a o Seraia o le tusiupu ia;

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
verses.sm: o Penaia le atalii o Ioiata sa pule ia i le au Kereti ma le au Peleti; a o atalii 0 Tavita o faipule i latou. Ua auina Sipa e
